## Collaboration Reflection

::::{.callout-warning icon="false"}
### {{<fa rocket >}} Activity: Inclusivity Rapid Assessment

:::{.panel-tabset}
### Part 1 - Pair Discussion

In pairs:

- Think back on a collaboration that you consider successful. What worked well? What were you doing? What were others doing? What conditions or practices supported the success of your team?

### Part 2 - Whole-Class Discussion

As a whole class, let's discuss your answers to the following questions:

- What are some common practices that worked well?
- Please share an "a-ha" moment or idea from your partner that you want to try in your group?
